title: Regular ultracompact objects with anti-de Sitter cores as polymerized vacuum solutions
summary: We present a systematic derivation of regular black hole solutions -- and their horizonless counterparts -- that achieve regularization via an anti-de Sitter core. These geometries emerge as polymerized vacuum solutions inspired by loop quantum gravity, constituting effective quantum gravity configurations that admit a Birkhoff-type theorem and are uniquely determined by their mass.
